# North Shore Judo
> Auckland's friendliest judo club in Takapuna, North Shore. Judo classes for kids, teens, and adults since 1969.

## Main Pages
- `Home -> https://northshorejudo.co.nz/`: About us, class timetable, pricing, FAQ, coaches, and location info
- `Sign Up -> https://northshorejudo.co.nz/join`: Register for judo classes online

## Key Facts
- Founded in 1969 by Sensei Ron Jones (5th Dan)
- Located at 34 Barrys Point Road, Takapuna, Auckland 0622, New Zealand (above Kathmandu takapuna)
- Head Coach: Simon Greenhill — Judo NZ recognised National Club Coach since 2006
- Coaching team: Simon Greenhill, Doug helped by many strong long time members
- Member of New Zealand Judo Federation, Auckland Judo Association, and International Judo Federation
- Competition-size dojo with free parking, kitchen, coffee, bathrooms, gym, seating etc.
- Super friendly club, all welcome.

## Classes & Pricing
- Pee Wees (ages 4–6): Tuesdays 6:00–6:30 PM, $36/month
- Juniors (ages 7–14): Tuesdays & Thursdays 6:45–7:45 PM, $73/month
- Seniors (15+): Tuesdays & Thursdays 8:00–10:00 PM, $73/month
- First class is always free
- Prices are per month for a 3-month term
